field.label: Enable CARP Failover
field.help: Only run the service on the CARP master device.

field.label: Interfaces
field.help: Interfaces to bridge mDNS traffic between. At least 2 interfaces must be selected.

field.label: Disable IPv4
field.help: Do not bridge mDNS traffic over IPv4.

field.label: Disable IPv6
field.help: Do not bridge mDNS traffic over IPv6.

field.label: Filter Mode
field.help: Optionally filter which mDNS services are bridged: allow only the listed services, or bridge everything except the listed services.

field.label: Service Filters
field.help: mDNS service labels to allow or deny, e.g. _ipp, _airplay, _googlecast.
